themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that perform research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention, including autonomous research agents and agent workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code, including AI code generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI for design research
themes.description: Explores AI applications specifically for the design process, including AI-assisted design tools, UI/UX prototyping with AI, and generative design.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Includes articles discussing AI tools and techniques for condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, such as research paper summaries or meeting insights.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers AI-powered platforms and tools designed to facilitate and enhance various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in software testing, including automated test generation, AI-driven quality assurance, and testing AI systems.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates user interactions with and the behavior of AI chatbots, including studies on their accuracy, user trust, and potential cognitive impacts.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI tools and methodologies for analyzing user feedback, sentiment, and brand reputation across various channels.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on employment, job roles, and the future of work, including AI's impact on recruitment and job displacement.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in survey design, distribution, and analysis, including AI-powered survey optimization and insights generation.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
